details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:186 (P1 step 4) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The evidence pack holds attacker-writable text (commit subjects, run titles), and the plan specifies only a banner. It does not specify sanitisation, routing neutralisation, or whether the pack is inserted before or after validate_heal_issue_body_routing.
  WHY: Inserted before validation, a `<!--` in the text rejects the whole heal body. Inserted after, unneutralised routing or marker text reaches the parsers. Severity: reviewers said MAJOR.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:250 (P5 step 2) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P5 adds a sixth `cause=` marker line, but scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py `validate_heal_issue_body_routing` (line 679) and `marker_header` (line 1237) allow only five, and the plan does not list them for change.
  WHY: With P5 on, every new heal body fails validation with reason `marker`, so no heal issue is filed.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:108,222-224,249 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: D3 defines six error classes, but the P3 `classify_failure_shape` returns only stall, timeout or other, and P5 builds `cause_key` from it.
  WHY: test_failure, crash and api_error failures at the same step collapse into `other` and are merged into one open heal.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:183,225-229,240-244 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P1 step 3, P3 step 4 and P4 step 1 expect per-commit file lists from one `compare` call, which returns only an aggregate `files[]`.
  WHY: Either extra calls break the stated budgets, or aggregate files are attributed to every commit, which puts wrong paths into the P4 frozen scope.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:202 (P2 step 3) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: heal_reproduce.sh exports both trees with `git archive`, but scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh lines 154-156 run `git merge-base` in the given tree, and an exported tree has no `.git`.
  WHY: Every reproduction returns a synthetic `no_merge_base` result and reports `unverified`, so the tests never run.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:206-208 (P2 step 4) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Only "fails at the failing SHA and passes at last green" and "fails at both" are classified. "Passes at the failing SHA" and "fails at last green but passes at the failing SHA" have no mapping.
  WHY: The implementer must guess, and a non-reproduction could be marked `reproduced` and feed the auto-approval path.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:229 (P3 steps 3-4) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P3 step 4 lists commits merged "on the first slow day", but no step defines that day, and step 3 defines regression only from the latest day's median.
  WHY: The boundary is arbitrary, so wrong commits can be listed as suspects. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 said NIT, the others said MAJOR.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:179,223 (P1 step 2, P3 step 2) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `actions/runs` and `workflows/<file>/runs` queries use `per_page=100` with no pagination or event filter.
  WHY: For busy workflows, 100 runs may cover under two days, so the baseline is missing, `regression=true` never fires, and the issue-linked run lookup can miss the run.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:270-276 (P7) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P7 reopens the original heal on recurrence, but intake already files a `gen+1` heal for an identical fingerprint against a closed heal (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py lines 5115-5120 and 5148-5154), and the plan does not reconcile the two.
  WHY: One recurrence can produce both a `gen+1` heal and a reopened original, so two issues plan the same fix.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:274 (P7 step 2) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: "The first completed run whose `head_sha` contains the merge commit" cannot match, because a `head_sha` is a single SHA.
  WHY: P7 verification skips every heal and never records a result. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 said BLOCKER, the others said MAJOR.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:272-276,81 (P7 step 2, Goals P7) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runs list is newest-first, so `per_page=5` does not return the earliest run after the merge. Goals also says "within 24 hours" while the steps use 7 days.
  WHY: A later unrelated passing run can be recorded as `held` and the `verified:v1` marker stops further checks, which hides a real recurrence.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:271,164 (P7 step 1, Scope) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P7 says the closed-heal list comes from the scan's existing list with no new call, but scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh line 162 queries `states:OPEN`, and the recovery-scan job runs only when candidates are nonzero.
  WHY: P7 has no closed-heal input and rarely runs, so the "no new call" claim and the second-recurrence escalation are wrong.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:209,82 (P2 step 5, Goals) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `--venv` change in scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh applies independently of `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REPRODUCE_ENABLED`, contradicting the "byte-identical when off" claim.
  WHY: With the switch off, gate results change from `unverified pytest_unavailable` to real pass or fail, so switching off no longer restores today's behaviour. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna said NIT, the others said MAJOR.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:317,328 (Tests, Risks) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The P3 budget of "at most 5" is below the six calls its steps list. The "about 12 extra calls" total omits P2's last-green call and P6's up to 3 fallback `GET actions/runs/<id>` calls, and P2, P4, P5 and P6 have no budgets.
  WHY: The planned call-count assertions cannot pass in the regression case.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:313 (Tests) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan places `test_intake_replays_*` in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_scope_tests.py, but it is in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py (for example line 9433).
  WHY: Later implement waves would extend the wrong test module.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:100 (Alternatives considered) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rationale "§23 keeps tokens out of model sandboxes" cites a rule that CLAUDE.md §23 ("GitHub Access") does not contain.
  WHY: The cited rationale cannot be traced. Documentation only.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:296,338 (P6 step 2, Rollout item 6) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P6 adds heal_port_to_default.sh to `issue_pr_status.yml`, a `workflow_call` workflow that consumer repos call, but the plan does not say how the script is fetched, and Rollout item 6 says only P2 reaches consumers.
  WHY: A consumer run could call an unfetched helper, or P6 could reach consumers unannounced. Severity disagreement: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said MAJOR, the others said NIT.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:260 (P6 step 1) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P6 parses `SCRIPT_REF: <sha>` from the evidence logs, but intake emits "Script ref the run staged: <sha>" (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 2412-2413, 2436-2438).
  WHY: The parser matches nothing, so the `code_ref` branch is dead when P1 is off.
- docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:237-241 (P4 step 1) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Adding P3 suspect-commit files to `SCOPE_INPUTS_FROZEN` is a trust-boundary expansion with no stated path validation. Rename-path artifacts from `compare` responses could enter the frozen marker.
  WHY: Garbage scope would block legitimate plan files via `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
